name: Justification By Faith
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that justification is not attained through the works of the law but through faith alone. The law reveals sin but cannot justify anyone, as no one can be made righteous by deeds (Romans 3:20, 3:28). Instead, faith in Jesus Christ, who justifies the ungodly, is counted as righteousness (Romans 4:5; Galatians 2:16). This faith brings peace with God and salvation from His wrath, accomplished through Christ's blood (Romans 5:1, 5:9).
